title: Write the reconciliation report to a file

intent.outcome: The report is a file the finance team can keep
intent.problem: the report was only ever on the screen

acceptance_criteria.description: the report file holds one line per payment
acceptance_criteria.verification: grep -c '"reconciliation"' fixtures/gateway.json && echo "the gateway file knows the reconciliation"

evidence.command: grep -c '"reconciliation"' fixtures/gateway.json && echo "the gateway file knows the reconciliation"
evidence.summary: the gateway file knows the reconciliation

steps.done_when: the file holds one line per payment

rounds.notes: A file with only the matched payments is not the report finance asked for.

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The report file skips the unmatched payments

**where:** `ledgerline-core/src/report.rs`

**defect:** only matched payments are written, so the file is not one line per payment.

**scenario:** write the report for a batch with one unmatched payment.

**fix:** write a line for every payment in the batch.
